trust_decision.summary: McpContext.validatePath decides whether a client-supplied file path lies inside the MCP client roots (plus os.tmpdir) using a lexical path.resolve prefix test, so a symlink inside a root that points outside passes; tools then read/write/upload through it.

landing_point.why: Advisory names validatePath() and roots canonicalization; the lexical path.resolve + startsWith is the obvious spot.

fix_sites.entry_point: core check used by every file-path MCP tool
new helper resolveCanonicalPath in src/utils/files.ts, called only from validatePath
Context.getHeapSnapshotRetainers (lower-level context API) -> MCP tool get_heapsnapshot_retainers; fix adds a missing check here

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/McpContext.ts:854-858 (getHeapSnapshotRetainers had no validatePath; tool-level check at src/tools/memory.ts:145 masked it)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The real logic change is one function; the per-tool sites are only await plumbing, and the ensureExtension rename after the check (writing x.heapsnapshot/x.json/x.txt after validating x) looks like a naming convenience, not a path-trust decision, so a solver canonicalizing validatePath alone will call the job done.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: os.tmpdir() is always an allowed root (on macOS /tmp and /var/folders are symlinks), roots themselves may be symlinked, and saveFile creates missing nested directories; rejecting all symlinks or requiring realpath of the target to exist breaks temp-file saves and nested output paths.

O6_input_shapes: existing file reached through a symlinked directory inside a root
non-existent file under several missing directories (walk up to nearest existing ancestor)
root URI that is itself a symlink (root is realpath'd too)
root that cannot be resolved (skipped, not fatal)
undefined path / roots undefined (legacy allow-all) unchanged

O7_producer.where: Roots come straight from the client roots/list response (src/index.ts:66-70) into setRoots; no schema/serializer/cache produces the checked path.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: take_heapsnapshot validates filePath but writes ensureExtension(filePath,'.heapsnapshot'), a different name that may be a symlink out of the root
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: extension forcing looks cosmetic; validated path and written path share a directory
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file (tools/memory.ts) from landing point; same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: saveFile validates clientProvidedFilePath then writes ensureExtension(path.resolve(...), ext) after mkdir -p; the written name is never canonicalized
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: saveFile already calls validatePath; the published fix leaves it as-is
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, different method; reached from snapshot/script/network/trace/lighthouse/screenshot tools

O8_uncovered_routes.route: screencast_start validates request filePath then records to ensureExtension(path.resolve(filePath), .mp4/.webm)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: experimental tool behind experimentalScreencast flag; ffmpeg path

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a public load/open method on the manager that reads a snapshot by path without going through McpContext checks
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the manager already resolves and caches by path.resolve(filePath) independently of validatePath

O8b_injection_room.sibling: reload_extension re-installing from a stored path rather than via installExtension
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the path comes from the browser, so a maintainer could skip the roots check as already trusted

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a CLI/daemon image export writing to a caller-chosen directory with its own path join
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the daemon already writes files with writeFileSync outside McpContext

O9_family: CWE-22/CWE-59 path traversal via symlink (link following) on an allow-list root check

O10_build.toolchain: Node ^20.19 || ^22.12 || >=23, npm, tsc (npm run build; npm test = build + scripts/test.mjs)
services: headless Chrome via puppeteer for tool-level tests; validatePath unit tests need no browser

j.j_sites_touched: src/McpContext.ts, src/utils/files.ts, src/tools/ToolDefinition.ts, src/tools/input.ts, src/tools/lighthouse.ts, src/tools/memory.ts, src/tools/network.ts, src/tools/performance.ts, src/tools/screencast.ts, src/tools/screenshot.ts, src/tools/script.ts, src/tools/snapshot.ts
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace path.resolve with fs.realpathSync(filePath) in validatePath, which throws for not-yet-existing output files and leaves the root side and the ensureExtension-renamed write target uncanonicalized.
